fit.title: property nav and affo
fit.reason: Property value, recurring rents, occupancy, lease terms and recurring capital expenditure drive a REIT. GAAP EPS is affected by real-estate depreciation; FFO/AFFO reconciliation and property NAV are required for a complete valuation.
fit.caution: Property value, recurring rents, occupancy, lease terms and recurring capital expenditure drive a REIT. GAAP EPS is affected by real-estate depreciation; FFO/AFFO reconciliation and property NAV are required for a complete valuation.
fit.basis: SEC issuer classification 6798: Real Estate Investment Trusts
fit.statement: No model is always most accurate. This is an explainable starting point, not a verified survey of current Wall Street analyst usage.
